name: support-ticket-orchestrator
description: Enterprise customer support orchestrator decomposing tickets, delegating to triage and policy specialists, and synthesizing audited replies.

skills.name: ticket_triage
skills.description: Classify ticket category, detect Priority SLA tags, and formulate policy questions.

skills.name: policy_lookup
skills.description: Retrieve ground-truth policy articles, error code definitions, and refund windows.

skills.name: reply_synthesis
skills.description: Compose customer-facing compliant replies with business logic assertions.

a2a_task_lifecycle_mapping.justification: Under standard A2A task lifecycle (submitted -> working -> input-required / completed / failed), the failed policy worker call should NOT transition the task to terminal 'failed'. Instead, it transitions to 'input-required', pausing execution to await the ticket owner agent to provide alternate policy context or human supervisor input.
a2a_task_lifecycle_mapping.a2a_vs_rest_value_add: A2A provides standardized stateful task lifecycles with asynchronous pause/resume across agents rather than ephemeral HTTP connection timeouts, and enables capability discovery via AgentCard rather than hardcoded endpoint contracts.
